title: Resolve equivalent-intent SQLite contention and triage related intermittent failures
summary: Investigate and fix the retained equivalent-intent delivery race: two real SQLite handles produce one ready intent but the losing prepare_delivery returns E_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE rather than withheld or E_DEPENDENCY_STALE. Separately triage the retained cancelled-work replacement and independent-stage failures without assuming a common cause. Ticket intake does not implement a fix or clear the failed validation.
in_scope: Bounded deterministic reproduction and narrow repair of the SQLite competing-equivalent-intent failure, preserving transaction, freshness, authority, budget and duplicate-suppression contracts.
Explicit investigation of the two retained intermittent failures, with evidence distinguishing implementation defects from fixture, clock, ordering or environment causes.
Retained local/CI receipts and a targeted verification plan; receiving-image evidence remains separately attributed to StateCivics.
out_of_scope: StateCivics KS-1121 implementation, pending statewide suite/review, merge/closure, image builds, deployment or activation.
PostgreSQL, new queues or retry orchestration, broad storage refactors, provider calls and MAT-040 qualification.
Changing the frozen monitoring contract, treating passing receiving tests as a SQLite fix, weakening assertions or relabelling genuine storage uncertainty as successful suppression.
The already-repaired installed walkthrough-schema lookup and broader MAT-077 package hardening.
implementation: Start from docs/validation/MAT-083-intake.md and the existing test integration.test_dispatch_races.DispatchRaces.test_distinct_equivalent_intents_compete_across_real_sqlite_handles. The retained local run failed in 30.536s; the losing intent-a prepare_delivery returned retriable E_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE at test_dispatch_races.py:126. No new reproduction or implementation fix was run during intake.

Instrument the existing SQLiteStore/DeliveryService boundary narrowly enough to locate the failing operation and interleaving. Retain Python/SQLite/platform, clocks, transaction timing, command/result identities and bounded synchronization evidence. Lock timeout, stale dependencies and fixture timing are hypotheses, not established causes.

Reuse independent SQLite handles against one database, existing control and budget services, delivery-key fencing and injected transport. Establish one ready winner and a justified withheld or stale loser for ordinary equivalent-intent contention; preserve truthful E_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE for actual persistence failure or indeterminate commits. Do not add blind handler or transport retries.

Triage integration.test_dispatch_races.DispatchRaces.test_cancelled_never_authorized_work_can_be_withdrawn_then_replaced_without_renewing_old_token: enqueue new-after-withdrawal returned outcome withheld with reasons [insufficient_evidence] and delivery:insufficient_evidence, where delivery_helpers.enqueue expected ready (test line 245/helper line 75 in the retained CI source). Observed in #26/Python 3.12 and #27/Python 3.11; not locally reproduced at intake.

Triage semantic.test_stages.StageTests.test_one_expired_member_does_not_abort_compatible_independent_member: c_contradiction was blocked instead of completed at test_stages.py:415. The test expects b_recovery E_DEPENDENCY_STALE, independent c_contradiction completed, three executor calls and final contradiction question. Observed in #26/Python 3.12 and #27/Python 3.11; not locally reproduced at intake.

Fix only demonstrated causes. If an intermittent finding needs distinct ownership or scope, retain the exact unresolved evidence and file a linked Matter follow-up before excluding it from this ticket's resolution. Preserve existing storage-fault, exact-command-recovery, lease fencing, revocation, budget and unknown-delivery controls.

Record bounded repeated synchronized runs and relevant affected regressions against exact commits/environments. Passing software checks do not qualify a provider or authorize live alerts. Keep KS-1121 receiving evidence and the incomplete external wheel digest separate from Matter's own receipts.

acceptance.criterion: Equivalent delivery intents compete across independent SQLite handles without unnecessary storage-unavailable failure or duplicate delivery.
acceptance.verification: Retain a before/after reproduction of the named test using real handles and controlled interleavings. Require exactly one ready winner and a withheld or E_DEPENDENCY_STALE loser, then one winner send/observed milestone with correct reservations and baseline. Retain bounded repetition counts, schedules and full outcomes; do not weaken the assertion to accept E_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE.

acceptance.criterion: The repair preserves truthful storage failure, uncertain outcomes, original authority and exact retry semantics.
acceptance.verification: Run affected existing storage-fault, duplicate-command, dispatch-fencing, budget, cancellation and delivery_unknown checks. A real I/O or uncertain-commit failure remains honest; recovery uses the original command and does not fabricate suppression, delivered history, a renewed token or another transport send.

acceptance.criterion: Both retained intermittent findings have an explicit evidenced disposition rather than being silently dismissed as flaky.
acceptance.verification: For each exact test, retain controlled reproduction or bounded investigation results with environment/clock/order details. Verify the replacement becomes ready without renewing the old token and the independent stage completes despite the other member expiring, or document the demonstrated alternative cause and a linked unresolved Matter ticket with its own acceptance. Do not claim a shared SQLite cause without evidence.

acceptance.criterion: Validation closeout distinguishes the repaired neutral behavior from external rehearsal and release authority.
acceptance.verification: Publish exact source/run receipts and any remaining failures. Attribute the 219-test receiving result and image inventory to StateCivics unless independently checked; obtain the full external wheel SHA-256 before treating it as a package pin. Preserve the rehearsal-only boundary and the host's pending suite/review/merge ownership.

tests: Controlled winner/loser ordering, stale-worker fencing, actual persistence faults and original-command recovery without duplicate sends.
risks: Treating all E_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE as duplicate suppression hides genuine durable-outcome uncertainty.
Blind retries, longer sleeps or a permissive assertion can hide a defect or bypass cancellation, budget and command identity.
The two intermittent findings have no demonstrated common cause and have not been locally reproduced in the retained intake evidence.
The external wheel digest is only the prefix 3d19879b…; the image and 219-test results are reported receiving evidence, not independent Matter verification or qualification.

reuse.application: Preserve the existing neutral transaction, outbox, fencing, failure and milestone contracts.
Reuse the existing real-handle race, cancellation fixture and independent-stage scenario; add only controls needed to reproduce demonstrated behavior.
Carry forward actual failing receipts without changing historical passes into a claim that the gap is cleared.
Keep later timing qualification and broad distribution hardening separate; neither is a prerequisite for this bounded neutral regression repair.
